name: Muha Meds Disposable (3rd Gen) | Pineapple Paradise
description: Pineapple Paradise packs tropical heat with ripe pineapple and citrus that slap right up front. This hybrid brings the mood up without overdoing it—smooth body calm with a heady, euphoric lift. Like catching a one-way flight to an island getaway.
